verdict.rationale: First-party marketing/docs explicitly claim 'Launch fleets of agents that work in parallel on ambitious tasks for hours or days' and background/scheduled always-on agents, matching the story closely. However, this is vendor claim only with no independent hands-on corroboration or detail on how parallel fleets are managed/monitored. Missing for 10: independent verification of long-running parallel agent fleets actually working reliably, details on orchestration/monitoring UI, and hands-on user reports confirming multi-day autonomous runs.
